answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 47120 Country: India Title: Dua for paralysis patient Question: My father is suffering from paralysis for last six months. He is on bed and not able to eat and speak. Please refer me dua in the light of Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 47120 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1170/902/H=10/1434) Recite surah Fatiha 41 times with durood 11-11 times on water and give it to your father to drink. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
